ladder.subject: A pigeon

contexts.safe: An empty concrete park plaza under bright daylight with open grass patches and park benches, shot with a wide view. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
contexts.enter: A pigeon waddles out from behind a wooden bench.
contexts.exit: The pigeon flaps its wings and flies away across the grass.

levels.state: A pigeon stands quietly on the grass far away near a park bench under daylight. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: A pigeon waddles out from behind a wooden bench.
levels.down: The pigeon flaps its wings and flies away across the grass.
holds: The pigeon turns its head and preaks its feathers.
The pigeon pecks softly at a green blade of grass.

levels.state: A pigeon stands on the grass path mid distance from the camera under daylight. Medium shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The pigeon hops forward onto the concrete pathway.
levels.down: The pigeon waddles backward onto the grassy area.
holds: The pigeon blinks its orange eyes and stretches its wings.
The pigeon shifts its weight from one foot to the other.

levels.state: A pigeon stands close to the camera on the concrete park path under daylight. Medium shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The pigeon takes a short flight and lands closer on the ground.
levels.down: The pigeon hops backward a short distance on the concrete.
holds: The pigeon fluffs its chest feathers and looks around.
The pigeon scratches its neck with a pink foot.

levels.state: A pigeon stands right beside the camera on a low stone ledge under daylight. Close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, shallow depth of field.
levels.up: The pigeon flutters up and lands right beside the camera.
levels.down: The pigeon steps down from the ledge to the ground below.
holds: The pigeon turns its head sideways to look around.
The pigeon ruffles its wing feathers in the breeze.

levels.state: A pigeon perches directly beside the camera on a wooden fence rail under daylight. Close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, shallow depth of field.
levels.up: The pigeon flaps its wings upward to perch on the fence rail.
levels.down: The pigeon drops down from the rail to the ground.
holds: The pigeon coos softly while tilting its glossy head.
The pigeon shakes its feathers and rests quietly.

contexts.safe: An empty wooden balcony with a metal railing overlooking a sunny courtyard under daylight. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
contexts.enter: A pigeon flies onto the wooden balcony floor.
contexts.exit: The pigeon launches off the railing and flies out of view.

levels.state: A pigeon stands near the far corner of an empty wooden balcony under daylight. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: A pigeon flies onto the wooden balcony floor.
levels.down: The pigeon launches off the railing and flies out of view.
holds: The pigeon stands still and looks over the courtyard.
The pigeon pecks gently at a stray seed.

levels.state: A pigeon stands mid distance on the wooden balcony boards under daylight. Medium shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The pigeon waddles closer across the wooden planks.
levels.down: The pigeon walks back toward the far balcony corner.
holds: The pigeon stretches one grey wing outward.
The pigeon blinks and turns its head toward the sky.

levels.state: A pigeon stands close on the wooden balcony floor under daylight. Medium shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The pigeon hops up onto a small stool on the balcony.
levels.down: The pigeon steps down from the stool to the floor.
holds: The pigeon puffs its iridescent neck feathers.
The pigeon taps its beak softly against the wood.

levels.state: A pigeon stands beside the camera on the balcony railing under daylight. Close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, shallow depth of field.
levels.up: The pigeon flies up to land on the metal balcony railing.
levels.down: The pigeon drops down from the railing to the floor.
holds: The pigeon looks around the sunny balcony space.
The pigeon smooths its tail feathers with its beak.

levels.state: A pigeon perches directly beside the camera on the balcony post under daylight. Close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, shallow depth of field.
levels.up: The pigeon hops onto the top of the wooden balcony post.
levels.down: The pigeon steps down onto the metal railing bar.
holds: The pigeon stands calmly in the warm daylight.
The pigeon closes its eyes briefly in the sunlight.
